public.title: Trapping Rain Water
public.description: Unit-width bars have nonnegative integer heights. Return the total water trapped after rain. There are 0 to 1000 bars with heights at most 10000.
hints: Water is bounded by the smaller of the best walls on each side.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Process the side with the smaller known wall; its water amount is already determined. O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
